narrative: - Joining us in 2010, Jeff and I go way back to high school. He lives in Illinois and has been playing fantasy sports for several years. Jeff has brought home 3 Awards, 2 Offensive Rookie of the Year(RB Kareem Hunt & James Robinson), and 3 Manager of the Year awards in 2014, 2015, and 2018. He has a Super Bowl appearance in 2017 losing in a close game. He finally got a Cathedral Bowl win in Season 17. He also has a division champ. Jeff is a quiet owner with no drama. Most of the time he doesn't post on the message board but will always vote and post when necessary. He might be quiet but he is a force that has made the Playoffs 10 out of the 15 seasons that he has been in the league. Jeff is still climbing the win list and sitting at 7th.
